title: Sound and Light
intro: Sort shake and sound, what you can see, and what a light beam does.
note: This is a sorting game model, and the real vibrating-sound, mystery-box, light-beam, and Signal Device Challenge activities still count.
summary: Sound comes from vibrations, and we see things only when light reaches our eyes. A material can let a light beam through, make it blurry, block it, or bounce it, and a flash pattern, like a Michigan lighthouse, can send a message.

stages.prompt: Where do shake and sound happen together, and where is it quiet and still?

cards.label: Plucked rubber band
cards.why: The band shakes back and forth, and you hear sound.
cards.hint: Is the band shaking, or is it still?

cards.label: Tapped drum and rice
cards.why: The tap makes sound, and the rice shakes.
cards.hint: Did something shake when there was a sound?

cards.label: Humming throat
cards.why: You feel a buzz in your throat when you hum.
cards.hint: Do you feel a shake when the sound happens?

cards.label: Shaking table ruler
cards.why: The ruler shakes, and your ear hears sound.
cards.hint: Is the ruler moving back and forth?

cards.label: Untouched still cup
cards.why: Nothing is shaking, so the cup stays quiet.

cards.label: Untapped still drum
cards.why: Nobody tapped it, so it is still and quiet.

stages.prompt: Can you see it, or is there no light to see by?

cards.label: Mystery box lit
cards.why: The light is on, so you can see inside.
cards.hint: Is the inside lit, or is it dark?

cards.label: Mystery box dark
cards.why: No light means you cannot see inside.
cards.hint: Is the inside lit, or is it dark?

cards.label: Toy by a lamp
cards.why: Light from the lamp reaches the toy and your eye.
cards.hint: Is light shining on the toy?

cards.label: Toy in dark room
cards.why: The room is dark, so you cannot see the toy.
cards.hint: Is light shining on the toy?

cards.label: Lamp turned on
cards.why: A lamp makes its own light, so you can see it.
cards.hint: Is it making light, or is the room dark?

cards.label: Lamp off in dark
cards.why: The lamp is off and the room is dark, so you cannot see it.
cards.hint: Is there any light to see by?

stages.prompt: What does this material do to a flashlight beam?

cards.label: Clear plastic
cards.why: Clear plastic lets the light beam go through.
cards.hint: Look at how clear this material is.

cards.label: Clear window
cards.why: A window lets light into the room.
cards.hint: Look at how clear this material is.

cards.label: Wax paper
cards.why: Wax paper lets some light through, but it looks blurry.
cards.hint: Look at how cloudy this material is.

cards.label: Cardboard sheet
cards.hint: Look at how thick and solid this material is.

cards.label: Shiny foil
cards.why: Foil makes the light bounce away.
cards.hint: Look at how shiny this material is.
